description:

• Learned production workflows: code review, git flow, and client feedback loops
• Delivered on tight agency timelines without sacrificing quality

• Engineered high-performance banking interfaces handling massive datasets for corporate clients
• Implemented micro-frontend architecture enabling independently deployable, parallel team delivery
• Optimized bundles and rendering to meet strict performance budgets
• Owned end-to-end feature delivery and mentored junior engineers

React engineer within a large consultancy, delivering enterprise web applications.
• Built features following strict quality, accessibility, and security standards
• Delivered within agile, cross-functional teams across client engagements
• Sharpened TypeScript, testing, and design-system skills at scale

Currently driving IT project delivery at Indonesia's largest state-owned bank.
• Bridge business needs and technical execution on banking platforms
• Coordinate cross-functional teams to ship on schedule with quality
• Focus on performance, reliability, and compliance for enterprise-scale systems
